important_distinctions.claim: Stretch markers carry linked clip envelopes and note expression; unlinked clip envelopes are unaffected. Stretch Factor does not change the loop region; x2 and /2 can.
Humanize start-time displacement is bounded by one quarter of a grid division in either direction.
Stored randomization differs from per-playback velocity deviation and probabilistic note/group triggering.
Session multi-edit is up to eight looped clips; Arrangement multi-edit is across up to eight tracks; Velocity/Chance only edits the foreground clip.

Undo changes note data, Reset changes tool parameters; bundled Velocity Shaper/Euclidean work in Standard and Suite, while editing/custom third-party Max tools require Suite or Standard plus Max for Live.
Chop allows 2–64 parts with a repeated maximum-16-part pattern; emphasis stretch is 2–8 times.
LFO Rate 1 means four beats; range is 1–1/128. Pitch Amount can reach twice the clip bend range; Base stays inside it. Slide/Pressure Amount and Base are -127…127.
Span Offset positive extends, but Variation positive shortens; these sign conventions are not interchangeable.
Seed lengths 1/128–whole note and velocities 1–127; Stacks Duration/Offset increments are eighths of original chord length; Euclidean supports up to four voices.
MPE controller input uses All Channels; zone settings are output-only. Lower global channel 1, upper 16, and one output zone per track.
Slicing preserves sampled audio and has 128-chain limit; conversion extracts notes and relies on transients/source quality, not original sound playback.
Quantize occurs before groove timing; Global Amount scales Timing/Random/Velocity up to 130%, not Quantize. Commit writes changes and clears assignment; extraction uses playing portion.
Tuning requires 48-semitone bend range in compatible external instruments; retuning can merge/shorten notes; reference-note selection alone does not audibly retune; Drum Racks bypass tuning.
Launch release behavior, Legato continuity, incoming velocity sensitivity, nudge global interval, linked loop counts, and unlinked bars–beats–sixteenths are separate controls.
